verdict.rationale: Docs and code samples show official SDKs across Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Rust (e.g., quickstart JS snippet, Rust table.delete/NewColumnTransform, Python create_fts_index), plus an embedding API with 'multi-language SDK support'. Community evidence corroborates real-world hands-on use of the JS/npm SDK in production apps. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of SDK feature parity across languages and clearer versioning/release cadence documentation.
